items.title: Ollie Gordon: Re-enters game after brief exit
items.text:
Gordon (undisclosed) checked back into Sunday's game against the Bengals following a brief departure in the fourth quarter, Omar Kelly of the Miami Herald reports.

items.title: Ollie Gordon: Hits sidelines Sunday
items.text:
Gordon (undisclosed) went to the medical tent during Sunday's game against the Bengals, Chris Perkins of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

items.title: Chris Olave: Victim of Shough's struggles Sunday
items.text:
Olave secured four of six targets for 46 yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

items.title: Marvin Harrison: Shipped to Houston
items.text:
The Cardinals agreed to trade Harrison and a seventh-round pick to the Texans for second- and sixth-round selections, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Paces pass catchers in homecoming
items.text:
Jefferson (ankle) brought in six of seven targets for 79 yards and a touchdown and rushed once for minus-11 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Minnesota.
